additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367525-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Charger out of order CRM:00921000961
additional_info.body:
Dear Ferdinand,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. We have checked the logs and understand that the charger is going out of order after the SCB goes offline because of LEM. Because the SIM card is going to expire, Router 1 connectivity gets lost and no reconnection happens. This leads to the LEM DC meters losing their timesync status "ok" after 48 hours. This, in turn, makes the DC outlets go out of order.
As per the existing FW it is an expected behavior and please be aware that I am checking other option to route it via Router 2.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367525-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Charger out of order CRM:00921000961
additional_info.body:
Dear Ferdinand,
I hope all is well with you. Please be aware that the issue is already addressed by FW v 6.1.x, which is going to be released by CW 08, 2025.  Root cause of the issue was LEM DC meters losing their timesync status "ok" after 48 hours of SCB offline. Until the FW fix is completed, we have to make sure the chargers (Equipped with LEMs) are connected to SCB at least once in every 48 hours.
Request your support to communicate the same to the CPO about issue resolution. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
